articles.title: Grant Cardone says he will keep buying bitcoin using real estate cash flows
articles.snippet: The real estate investor pitched his model as a treasury company backed by cash-flowing property rather than stock sales, framing the slide in bitcoin as a chance to accumulate.

articles.title: BlackBerry is making a massive comeback as an 'uncrashable' software layer for AI and robotics
articles.snippet: BlackBerry's stock is surging after the company's massive earnings beat and is pivoting into becoming a critical component of the AI and robotics boom.

articles.title: Spain regulator rules out extension for non-MiCA compliant crypto companies
articles.snippet: Carlos San Basilio said that “there will be no exceptions ​or extensions” to the MiCA deadline requiring crypto exchanges offering services to EU-based users to be licensed.

articles.title: AscendEX withdrawal complaints mount as ZachXBT questions reserves
articles.snippet: Multiple users reported delayed AscendEX withdrawals after ZachXBT flagged potential liquidity issues and urged the exchange to explain its reserves.

articles.title: Polymarket hit by $2.9M theft, users to be refunded
articles.snippet: Polymarket said it contained the compromise and removed the affected dependency after attackers injected a malicious script into its frontend.
